buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 4. Rate Contract The Purchase orders placed through the rate of this bid shall be placed by . The order shall be placed by buyer separately based on the requirement. 5. Grand Total 236 1. The successful bidder shall supply the batteries as per the specifications and quantiti es mentioned above :- 2. The successful bidder shall supply only brand-new, unused and genuine batteries of reputed brands such as Exide, Amaron, Tata Green, SF Sonic or equivalent approved brands. The batteries shall conform to the latest applicable BIS/ISI standards/specifications a nd shall bear the manufacturer's identification marks. 3. The bidder shall quote the net rate for the supply of new batteries after adjustme nt of the Buy-Back value of old/used batteries. The quoted net rate shall be inclusive o f all applicable taxes, duties, transportation, loading/unloading and other incidental charges. § The successful bidder shall take back the old/used batteries against the supply of new batteries at no additional cost to the Municipal Corporation, Chandigarh. The cos t/value of the old/used batteries taken under the Buy-Back arrangement shall be adju sted against the cost of the new batteries supplied, and the net rate quoted in the bi d shall be considered for evaluation and payment. § The bidder shall be responsible for collection, loading, transportation and disposal /recycling of the old/used batteries in accordance with the applicable rules and regul ations, without any additional financial liability on the Municipal Corporation, Chandig arh. § The rates quoted by the successful bidder shall remain firm and fixed during the e ntire contract period. No claim on account of increase in the cost of raw material, bat tery components, transportation, labour, taxes, duties or any other reason shall be e ntertained. 4. The successful bidder shall deliver the batteries at the MCC Motor Garage, Industrial Area, Phase-I, Chandigarh, or at any other location within the jurisdiction of the Municipal Corporat ion, Chandigarh, as directed by the Department. 5. The successful bidder shall provide a minimum warranty of 24 months from the date of s upply/installation, as applicable, for all batteries supplied. 6. Any battery found defective during the warranty period shall be replaced free of cost by t he successful bidder within 07 days from the date of receipt of intimation from the Departm ent. 7. The successful bidder shall provide the manufacturer's warranty card/certificate, tax invoi ce, test certificate, if applicable, and other relevant documents at the time of supply. 8. The Department reserves the right to inspect and verify the batteries at the time of delive

ry. Any battery found to be damaged, old stock, refurbished/reconditioned, defective, or not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be liable to rejection and shall be replaced by the supplier immediately, at no additional cost to the Municipal Corporation. The successf ul bidder shall take back the old/used batteries against the supply of new batteries under th e Buy-Back arrangement. 9. Payment shall be released only after satisfactory receipt, inspection, verification and certi fication of the supplied batteries by the authorized officer/officials of the Department and su bject to compliance with all applicable terms and conditions of the bid. 10. The Municipal Corporation, Chandigarh, reserves the right to increase or decrease the q uantity of batteries during the contract period, depending upon the actual requirement, subj ect to the applicable rules, terms and conditions of the bid/contract. 11. The successful bidder shall comply with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, BIS requir ements, environmental norms and battery waste management/recycling requirements prev ailing from time to time. The Department shall not be responsible for any violation committe d by the supplier. 12. In case of any dispute relating to the quality, specifications, acceptance or rejection of b atteries, interpretation of the terms and conditions of the bid, or any matter arising out of or in connection with the contract, the decision of the Commissioner, Municipal Corporation, Ch andigarh, or the competent authority, as applicable under the prevailing rules, shall be final and binding upon the successful bidder. 13. The Department reserves the right to cancel the supply order or terminate the contract, wholly or partly, in case of persistent delay, failure to supply, supply of defective/non-confor ming batteries, breach of any term or condition, or unsatisfactory performance by the succe ssful bidder, in accordance with the applicable contractual provisions. .
